description.value:
You carry a Teratoma's own dying breath in your chest.

Gift — You don't need to breathe for up to 1 hour, and when you finally do, the breath heals you: regain HP equal to your level. Tithe — The Teratoma gave up part of its own last breath to grant this. It remembers what dying felt like, through you, every time you use it — and it always eventually asks why you're keeping it waiting.

cinderfall.incomplete: The once-per-day 'don't breathe for up to 1 hour, then heal HP equal to your level on your next breath' has no rule-element equivalent: it's a limited-use self-triggered heal with a concrete formula, which needs a granted, frequency-tracked action item, the same class of gap as Loyal-Blood/Second-Wind-Lung.
